articles.title: Buzzing stocks for Sept 16: Bharat Forge, Titagarh Rail, BHEL, Cochin Shipyard, Thermax, Blue Star, Allen Blenders, Tata Communications, Mazagon Dock
articles.summary: Bharat Forge Ltd. and Pratt & Whitney Canada are collaborating to integrate advanced turboprop engines into High-Altitude, Long-Endurance (HALE) unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). This partnership aims to enhance the capabilities of long-range surveillance drones, potentially boosting India's indigenous defence manufacturing and aerospace technology development for strategic applications, offering enhanced operational endurance.
